text:
Taylor: Quick follow-up thread for the memory/KV OOM postmortem. We need a tight owner/ETA list and a lightweight sync cadence.
Maya: Got it. I'll own deep allocation profiling and produce flamegraphs + heap diffs.
Samir: I'll take eviction-policy experiments and a simple evictions vs resident-size dashboard.
Eli: I'll try jemalloc/bg-compaction tweaks and measure fragmentation % after runs.
Taylor: Proposed actions: 
  - [Maya] deterministic allocations + sampling; collect `alloc.trace` and `heap.snap` from staged replay. ETA: Tue EOD.
  - [Samir] run LRU, segmented, and TTL-based eviction on stg nodes; capture hit-rate, evictions/s, and avg-resident. ETA: Thu.
  - [Eli] apply `jemalloc` background purge every 60s on canary, measure p99 latency and CPU delta; ETA: Mon.
  - [infra-bot] file tickets and attach logs/traces; create ephemeral queue guard during noisy tests.
infra-bot: Tickets created: INF-3291 (alloc-profiling), INF-3292 (eviction-experiments), INF-3293 (gc-compaction). Links: https://jira.redwood/INF-3291 etc.
oncall: Reminder: set temp alert thresholds to avoid wide pages while experiments run.
Maya: I'll run `python3 tools/replay.py --trace traces/repro-2026-03-22 --max-time 3600 --out alloc.trace` then `flamegraph.pl alloc.fold > alloc.svg`. Will attach in INF-3291.
Samir: For eviction tests I plan `segment_bytes=65536 max_fill=0.8` and an aggressive run with `segment_bytes=32768 max_fill=0.6`. Will note latency regressions.
Eli: Command notes to capture stats: `jeprof --text /tmp/prof.heap > jemalloc.txt` and `cat /proc/<pid>/smaps | grep -i rss` after runs. I'll push a canary config change and monitor CPU before wider rollout.
Taylor: Can we add a short daily status line to each ticket? One-liner: "progress: X" so we can close by Apr 12 or escalate.
Maya: Ack. Posting flamegraph to INF-3291 by Tue.
Samir: Will post staging graphs Wed.
Eli: Canaries Mon, will report perf/cost.
Taylor: Weekly check-in proposed Thu 09:00 PST x3. I'll create calendar and invite owners.
infra-bot: Calendar invite "KV frag remediation sync" created for Thu 09:00 PST, 3 occurrences.
oncall: I'll add a temporary OOM-safety throttle to staging to reduce blast radius.
Maya: Note: sampling misses sub-1ms allocations; I'll capture both sampling and full snapshots where feasible.
Samir: If eviction reduces resident but raises miss latency, we may need a hybrid solution (hotset pinning). Will prototype.
Taylor: Thanks; post blockers here and tag me. End goals: reproduce fragmentation reliably, validate eviction/GC mitigations vs latency, land conservative safe changes by Apr 12.
Maya: uploading first artifacts now.
Samir: starting seg tests in stg in 30m.
Eli: prepping jemalloc canary.
